summary.testFileDelta: Only an existing outcome test receives explicit JsonValue object narrowing for strict TypeScript; the 11 new regression cases are byte-identical.

authority.boundary: Nine true permission assertions failed; two coder cases also stopped at the separately reproduced preexisting read-tracking metadata defect. Eleven new assertion bodies retained byte-for-byte through extraction.

callOwnership.boundary: Six initial real-ledger cases; the same-execution replay guard already passed. Four additional validation/read-failure cases and strict type narrowing were added before the final 10-case pass.

readTracking.boundary: Both old-source cases failed before raw execution with a self-described read_file protocol mismatch. A later incorrect expected error string and explicit payload narrowing were corrected; original failed reports remain.

limits: Fixture models and real local SQLite/filesystem/candidate tools; no live-model quality or latency claim.
Shared model/session lifecycle, compaction, child Run lineage and restartable child work remain unimplemented.
Parent and child still share a ledger; adversarial equality between a parent raw ID and a derived child infrastructure ID fails closed rather than granting a second execution.
